$comment: Environments, declared once and in promotion order (ADR-001 amendment 12): a host run reads one (`.env.<id>`), a target tree splits by them, CD promotes through them in this order. workspace: the environment remote dev syncs source into. A host adds one (e.g. staging) in its manifest (`catalogs.environments`, with `after`) and touches no code. runDefault: what a host run reads without --env; deployDefault: what a deploy targets without one.
